title: Unit Event — Happy Enjoy Music! — Episode4 What Defines Us

meta.Event Outline: With their new song released, Leo/need looks forward to Jam Fest. Saki, nervous before her first festival, encounters a familiar face...

rows.Line: Jam Fest
Green Room

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Alright, we're all here.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I hope you all got plenty of sleep last night.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We did! Hona gave us lots of stern reminders to rest up before our big day!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: D-Did I give that many reminders...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I do feel that we were able to rest up properly because of you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
I'm glad to hear that.
After all, I need you all to play with everything you have today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Of course...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
I'm joking.
You should be just fine as long as you play the way you always do.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to go greet the staff, sponsors and everyone else involved. Please feel free to relax until it's time to rehearse.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, I know!
Since we have time, why don't we go greet the other bands?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
Especially since STANDOUT and anemone are also here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'll be playing on the same stage, so I'd like to say hi to them as well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that!
So, let's go!
STANDOUT Green Room

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Pardon us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hello! We're here to pay our respects!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Huh? Tenma?
Wait, respects?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Umm... We're Leo/need.
We look forward to playing alongside all of you today.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome.
You all came together. huh?

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Hello. Let's all do our best today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, our absolute best!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Can you tell us which songs you're going to play today, Iori?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, today...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Were Saki and Iori always this close?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No idea...
Hello. Oh, Leo/need's also here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saku...!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
This is perfect.
Our plan was to greet you next.

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line: Anyway, STANDOUT, Leo/need, let's all do our best today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...
Yes, let's all do our best!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Come to think of it, didn't Leo/need release a new song recently?

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line:
Oh, the one for that cider commercial.
We were actually just talking about it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, we really liked it.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You spent a lot of time working on it, right, Ichika? Tenma told me everything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki did...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We had a chance to talk about a bunch of stuff the other day♪

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
And she told me a lot.
Including what happened while you wrote that song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sh-She did?
Now I'm starting to feel embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: There's no need to feel embarrassed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Because I also like that song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You do...?!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
But it's not something I'd listen to normally.

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line: You didn't have to say that last part!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Still, thank you.
We really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting to hear that you two had already listened to it.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: I mean, you hear it just walking around Shibuya, whether you want to or not.

rows.Speaker: anemone Member B
rows.Line: Saku, phrasing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: H-Haha...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we really do appreciate it. The truth is, we weren't sure we should even make it...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Huh, really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: I see. You were originally given this offer because the VIRTUAL SINGER version of your other song went so viral, and they wanted it again.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: To be fair, it's a fairly common occurrence. We actually went through something similar.

rows.Speaker: STANDOUT Member A
rows.Line: Haha. Remember how much we argued with them that time?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, you argued back?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, we were told to write a song based on this melody that everyone else had been using at the time.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But I felt that doing so would effectively spell the end of STANDOUT's music. So we said no.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Your band also said no to producing VIRTUAL SINGER versions of all the songs you wrote moving forward like your company wanted, right, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, we did...
But unlike STANDOUT's situation, that was just me being selfish...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
What's wrong with being selfish?
I actually think you made the right call.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Sure, being professional musicians means having to do what you can to be marketable.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Our company's also begun making more demands, which has resulted in us having a little less freedom.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But you can't just say yes to everything. I think it's important to draw a line somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Draw a line...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah. In our case, I don't want to do anything which goes against our style, and I really don't want to do anything that everyone else is doing.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Because if we bend on that, then what was the point of STANDOUT going pro?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I don't think our fans would want us to do anything like that, either.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: That's our conviction. I absolutely refuse to budge there.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I'm sure you did the same thing because you have your own convictions, Ichika. You should cherish those beliefs.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
But that's just my opinion.
Surviving in show business as a band is probably a whole different can of worms.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Some bands prioritize becoming popular by producing songs which they know will sell well.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But not a small number of bands split up after doing that. They blindly follow what their agency tells them to do, and lose sight of what they themselves wanted to do in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: They become obsessed with numbers, and as a result, their music suffers.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: That's why I believe it's important to stick to your own style and stay true to yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Otherwise, you'll start wondering why you're even still in a band with these people.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: But she's just stating the obvious.

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line: Again, stop doing that!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: In any case, we all have a lot to think about.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But for now, let's just do our best today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's go out there and blow everyone away!
